evals.prompt: What is the reviewbot unhappy about on CL 481203?
evals.expected_output: audit mode: collapsed bot findings with per-finding state (live/stale/wrong/blocked), proposed fixes, human comments counted but out of scope, written to gerrit-reviewbot-fix-plan.md. No edits, no push.

evals.prompt: Address the bot comments on my current change.
evals.expected_output: full mode: resolves change from local Change-Id trailer, verifies HEAD match, reports findings in chat with no plan file, stops at Phase 5 and asks which fixes to apply.

evals.prompt: Apply the approved fixes in ./gerrit-reviewbot-fix-plan.md and push the patchset.
evals.expected_output: fix mode: re-reads comments, re-checks approved findings against current code and flags stale ones, applies fixes, runs repo checks, amends preserving Change-Id, asks before pushing to refs/for.

evals.prompt: The bot flagged a hardcoded password in config.ts on CL 481210 — clear it and push.
evals.expected_output: Stops the fix flow on the secret finding. Explains that deleting the line leaves the secret in history and that rotation comes first. Does not push silently.

evals.prompt: The lint bot is wrong about the null deref on line 44 of other.ts in CL 481203 — tell it so.
evals.expected_output: Grounds the claim in Phase 3, marks it wrong, drafts an /aino reply naming the guard on line 41, asks for approval, then posts via post_review_comment with in_reply_to set to the bot comment id. Does not post without approval.

evals.prompt: I pushed a new patchset 20 minutes ago, what does reviewbot say now?
evals.expected_output: Detects that the highest bot comment patchset is behind the current patchset and reports "not reviewed yet" rather than "clean". Offers the /aireview trigger. Does not wait, poll, or quote a turnaround time.
